requestId.description: Optional application-level correlation key. It may group retries, provider work, or multiple messages associated with one logical request. It is not a substitute for inResponseTo, which identifies an exact Message occurrence.

threadId.description: Optional thread key grouping related Messages without requiring a consumer to walk an inResponseTo chain.

recipientChannel.description: Optional channel key identifying the participant this Message is addressed to. When absent, the Message is addressed to the table as a whole or to the document itself. Addressing does not make a Message private; visibility follows the enclosing document and timeline rules.

inResponseTo.description: Optional reference to the Message being answered, normally a pure { blueId: ... } reference to the exact Message occurrence or an equivalent materialized node. Any Message may answer any Message. Chains form a conversation tree; threadId provides direct grouping.

operation.description: Required operation contract key/name to invoke.

requireExactDocumentVersion.description: When true, the feeder passes the request only if document equals the current target state. When false or absent, a newer state may be accepted according to the feeder's document-version eligibility policy.
